decided_by: PI, 2026-09-28: finish 2v2 -- Share-Encoder, Fully Shared+z, Generalist -- then noise, then lock.
claim_boundary: 2v2 sharing baselines, n=128 matched seeds (sealed_confirmatory block shared by all arms); mean effects are the headline, 95% intervals for figures; not PAPER-FAITHFUL

SEPARATED_REFERENCE.label: STANDARDIZED_2V2_SEPARATED_GENERALIST_REF
SEPARATED_REFERENCE.why: Delta_G = V(ours) - V(pi_G) must be paired by seed (GENERALIST_DEFINITION_V1#SCORING_locked); ours is re-scored on this block for that pairing only. The 2v2 main Separated value stays the fresh confirmatory +0.117/+0.539.
SEPARATED_REFERENCE.system: split composite exactly as in the confirmatory pass: pi_D on DEFEND + repaired pi_A frozen on ATTACK, roles fixed for the episode, CLOSEST_DEFENDS k=1; pi_B the repaired pi_B

delta_G.Delta_G_A: V(split pi_A+D, A) from this reference minus V(pi_G, A), paired by seed
delta_G.Delta_G_B: V(pi_B, B) from this reference minus V(pi_G, B), paired by seed

POLES.source: resolved from the certification at run time (experiments/pole_attestation.py); must equal these hashes (the ones the dataset was collected on)

EVALUATION.sharing_arms: forced z, no router, deterministic; Delta_A = V(z0,A) - V(z1,A), Delta_B = V(z1,B) - V(z0,B); every z x pole cell on all 128 seeds
EVALUATION.generalist: no z; V(pi_G,A), V(pi_G,B) on all 128 seeds
EVALUATION.tie_or_reversal: a sharing arm with a Delta mean <= 0 writes its integrity flag and still seals; a row-level audit precedes any interpretation
EVALUATION.crash_safety: every finished episode is appended to a fingerprinted PARTIAL file; launches pass --resume

LAUNCH.preflight: every command with --dry-run passes; this spec and the evaluators committed; scientific tree clean
LAUNCH.concurrency: the four labels are independent (fresh env per episode, deterministic actions) and may run in parallel

NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_SPEC: replacing the 2v2 main Separated value with the reference run
